metadataRaw.title: How to Fix One Sided Hip Pain FOR GOOD
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to quickly fix one-sided hip pain by targeting the muscles commonly associated with hip discomfort, including the glutes (buttocks).

The video is divided into two parts. The first part focuses on stretching exercises for immediate relief, while the second part covers strengthening exercises for long-term relief—and hopefully to eliminate the hip pain for good.

Both approaches work differently, so to get the best results, try both and see which provides the most relief.

As a bonus, all of these exercises can be done at home with no equipment, and some may offer quick relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now to learn how to get rid of one-sided hip pain at home!

0:00 Intro
0:47 Muscle Release 1
3:35 Muscle Release 2
